counterfactuals.name: CF_EXACT_DUPLICATE_REMOVED
counterfactuals.recipe: Remove later repeated source/capability pair in isolated copy; never a repair

counterfactuals.name: CF_PREFER_EXECUTABLE
counterfactuals.recipe: After dedup, suppress unresolved/context dispositions where an executable proposal exists; destroys proposed meaning and is not eligible

counterfactuals.name: CF_PREFER_UNRESOLVED
counterfactuals.recipe: After dedup, retain unresolved instead of other routes on that source; exposes remaining rejection, no fulfillment

counterfactuals.name: CF_PREFER_RETAINED
counterfactuals.recipe: After dedup, retain context instead of other routes on that source; diagnostic only
